en: A black and white photograph of a rural landscape with meadows and scattered wildflowers in the foreground. There are two clusters of traditional Scandinavian-style buildings, one closer and one further away, partially surrounded by forest. The word 'Ånungård' appears in the bottom left of the image. The edges of the image are bordered by a grey band containing credits to the photographer (Okänd, Swedish for 'unknown') and the Sundsvalls museum.
